# Velocity Vision

> Velocity Vision is self-serve B2B campaign software. Teams start with their own authorised business data and one brief, create a complete editable campaign pack, review and approve the assets, choose controlled activation routes, then manage replies, follow-up and early pipeline in the same workspace.

Operated by Global Solutions Management LLC (Delaware, USA). Website: velocity-outreach.com

The current complete campaign pack includes strategy, landing & offer copy, email sequences, a social pack, press release, video scripts, paid-ad copy and lead capture. Approved email can move through governed sending on eligible paid plans; approved social text can be handed to the customer's own Buffer account; other campaign assets remain under customer control for use in the channels they choose.

Velocity Vision is software, not an agency. It does not provide managed campaigns, PR distribution, media buying or creative services; it does not scrape contacts or sell lists; it does not send or publish anything automatically; and it does not guarantee compliance, deliverability, replies, pipeline or revenue. Customers supply their own lawfully obtained business data and remain responsible for lawful basis, sender identity, content review, suppression handling and every activation decision.
